```lean
import Complexity.Computability.Circuit.Formula
import Mathlib.Data.Rat.Defs
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sum
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.ColumnRowPartitioned

/-! Isolated native rational-formula representation probe. -/

namespace Cslib.RationalFormulaProbe
open Circuits

inductive RatOp where
  | const : ℚ → RatOp
  | add | mul | inv
  deriving DecidableEq

abbrev ratSignature : Signature where
  Op := RatOp
  Arity
    | .const _ => 0
    | .add | .mul => 2
    | .inv => 1

abbrev RFormula (n : ℕ) := Formula ratSignature n

def const {n : ℕ} (a : ℚ) : RFormula n := .gate (.const a) Fin.elim0
def add {n : ℕ} (f g : RFormula n) : RFormula n := .gate .add ![f, g]
def mul {n : ℕ} (f g : RFormula n) : RFormula n := .gate .mul ![f, g]
def inv {n : ℕ} (f : RFormula n) : RFormula n := .gate .inv ![f]

-- The actual dependent shape from the old affine representation, on native formulas.
@[reducible] def Index {n : ℕ} : RFormula n → Type
  | .input _ | .gate (.const _) _ => Unit ⊕ Unit
  | .gate .add a | .gate .mul a => Index (a 0) ⊕ Index (a 1)
  | .gate .inv a => Index (a 0) ⊕ Unit

@[reducible] instance indexFintype {n : ℕ} : (f : RFormula n) → Fintype (Index f)
  | .input _ | .gate (.const _) _ => inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Unit ⊕ Unit))
  | .gate .add a | .gate .mul a =>
      letI := indexFintype (a 0)
      letI := indexFintype (a 1)
      inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Index (a 0) ⊕ Index (a 1)))
  | .gate .inv a =>
      letI := indexFintype (a 0)
      inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Index (a 0) ⊕ Unit))

@[reducible] instance indexDecidableEq {n : ℕ} : (f : RFormula n) → DecidableEq (Index f)
  | .input _ | .gate (.const _) _ => inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq (Unit ⊕ Unit))
  | .gate .add a | .gate .mul a =>
      letI := indexDecidableEq (a 0)
      letI := indexDecidableEq (a 1)
      inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq (Index (a 0) ⊕ Index (a 1)))
  | .gate .inv a =>
      letI := indexDecidableEq (a 0)
      inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq (Index (a 0) ⊕ Unit))

def row {n : ℕ} : (f : RFormula n) → Matrix Unit (Index f) ℚ
  | .input _ | .gate (.const _) _ => Matrix.fromCols 1 0
  | .gate .add a => Matrix.fromCols (row (a 0)) (row (a 1))
  | .gate .mul a => Matrix.fromCols (row (a 0)) 0
  | .gate .inv _ => Matrix.fromCols 0 (-1)

theorem card_index {n : ℕ} (f : RFormula n) :
    Fintype.card (Index f) = f.size + f.leafSize + 1 := by
  induction f with
  | input i => simp [Index, Formula.size, Formula.leafSize]
  | gate op args ih =>
    cases op <;>
      simp [Index, Formula.size, Formula.leafSize, ratSignature,
        Fin.sum_univ_two, ih] <;> omega

-- A generic constructive equality procedure, not specific to rational operations.
def formulaDecidableEq {σ : Signature} {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq σ.Op] :
    (f g : Formula σ n) → Decidable (f = g)
  | .input i, .input j => decidable_of_iff (i = j) (by simp)
  | .input _, .gate _ _ => isFalse (by intro h; cases h)
  | .gate _ _, .input _ => isFalse (by intro h; cases h)
  | .gate op args, .gate op' args' => by
      by_cases hop : op = op'
      · subst op'
        letI (i : Fin (σ.Arity op)) : Decidable (args i = args' i) :=
          formulaDecidableEq (args i) (args' i)
        exact if hargs : ∀ i, args i = args' i then
          isTrue (congrArg (Formula.gate op) (funext hargs))
        else isFalse (by intro h; cases h; exact hargs (fun _ => rfl))
      · exact isFalse (by intro h; cases h; exact hop rfl)

instance {n : ℕ} : DecidableEq (RFormula n) := formulaDecidableEq

-- Partiality belongs to the interpretation, independently of the syntax.
def ratInterpretation : Interpretation ratSignature (Option ℚ)
  | .const a, _ => some a
  | .add, a => do pure ((← a 0) + (← a 1))
  | .mul, a => do pure ((← a 0) * (← a 1))
  | .inv, a => do
      let v ← a 0
      if v = 0 then none else some v⁻¹

example : (inv (const 0) : RFormula 0).eval ratInterpretation Fin.elim0 = none := by decide
example : (inv (const 2) : RFormula 0).eval ratInterpretation Fin.elim0 = some ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹) := rfl
example : (mul (const 0) (inv (const 0)) : RFormula 0).eval
    ratInterpretation Fin.elim0 = none := by decide
example : (add (const 1) (const 2) : RFormula 0) ≠ add (const 2) (const 1) := by decide
example {n : ℕ} (f g : RFormula n) : Index (mul f g) = (Index f ⊕ Index g) := rfl
example : Fintype.card (Index (inv (add (const 1) (const 2)) : RFormula 0)) = 5 := by decide

-- A proof induction principle preserves the five source cases.
theorem inductionOn {n : ℕ} {P : RFormula n → Prop} (f : RFormula n)
    (hvar : ∀ i, P (.input i)) (hconst : ∀ a, P (const a))
    (hadd : ∀ f g, P f → P g → P (add f g))
    (hmul : ∀ f g, P f → P g → P (mul f g))
    (hinv : ∀ f, P f → P (inv f)) : P f := by
  induction f with
  | input i => exact hvar i
  | gate op args ih =>
    cases op with
    | const a =>
      have h : args = Fin.elim0 := funext fun i => Fin.elim0 i
      simpa only [const, ← h] using hconst a
    | add =>
      have h : args = ![args 0, args 1] := by funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
      simpa only [add, ← h] using hadd (args 0) (args 1) (ih 0) (ih 1)
    | mul =>
      have h : args = ![args 0, args 1] := by funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
      simpa only [mul, ← h] using hmul (args 0) (args 1) (ih 0) (ih 1)
    | inv =>
      have h : args = ![args 0] := by funext i; fin_cases i; rfl
      simpa only [inv, ← h] using hinv (args 0) (ih 0)

example {n : ℕ} (f : RFormula n) : 0 < f.size + f.leafSize := by
  induction f using inductionOn with
  | hvar i => simp
  | hconst a => simp [const]
  | hadd f g ihf ihg => simp [add, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  | hmul f g ihf ihg => simp [mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  | hinv f ih => simp [inv]

end Cslib.RationalFormulaProbe

```
